scope: Actual Unit 1 learner master, all 46 Cook prompts, all 46 original tasks, all 13 supplied-help rows; no answer key consulted.

reading_method.learner_master: Read all 840 lines, including exposition, vocabulary, all 92 tasks, readings/help and source notes.
reading_method.contract: Read productive/recognition/bounded scope, all 8 example records, authoring rules, assigned item targets/types, source-span/support records and requirement status mapping. Did not treat the contract as linguistic proof or read any answer-key file.
reading_method.source_prompts: Read all three exact transcripts and actually inspected Cook exercise page images p1/PDF9 and p2/PDF10.
reading_method.reading_source: Read the faithful Creation transcription and source audit; protected text compared exactly with the existing contract. Its images were not newly re-inspected for this novelty-only task.
reading_method.beads_and_git: Coordinator only; no worker Beads/Git calls.

summary.important_limit: No claim that every item is equally novel: I.2 is largely reference-form assembly; the supplied reading is not independent mastery of its untaught constructions.

findings.finding: Whole worked-answer exposure in CASE06 and whole worked-analysis exposure in REVIEW02.
findings.resolution: Change the two exposition examples and refresh the review context; preserve the source reading and Cook prompts.

findings.finding: The main forms/copula block mostly names cells already printed; it cannot be the principal evidence for transfer.
findings.resolution: Retain full reference paradigms; redesign original prompts around meaning, role, number/person/tense change and error contrasts. Keep F08 as explicit reference.

findings.finding: The original short readings print complete answers to three earlier composition tasks and reuse an already solved analysis.
findings.resolution: Rewrite the two original passages as fresh connected scenes under the same teaching scope; preserve the exact Cook reading separately.

findings.finding: Several reading questions simply repeat supplied analyses or translations. Essential support must not be withheld to create artificial difficulty.
findings.resolution: Separate guided support checks from applications of already taught nominal/copular grammar; trim only redundant full solutions where actual prerequisites remain supplied.

findings.finding: All 46 Cook prompts are intact and no complete Cook answer is a preceding worked example. I.1 offers basic gender/article selection, I.2 mostly combines printed N pl diagnostics, and I.3 offers richer new dependencies.
findings.resolution: Preserve all prompts. Keep replacement examples distinct from them, and use original practice for stronger rule-application evidence.

findings.finding: COMP04 is only a same-pattern lexical substitution; CASE10 and REVIEW04 can demand a new number/role decision.
findings.resolution: Use the finite task/example changes specified in the item records, without new vocabulary systems.

course_wide_transfer_criterion.name: Meaning-led transfer with bounded support
rules: Preserve every source prompt, source ID, complete paradigm and necessary lexical diagnostic. Novelty is not created by hiding reference information.

A transfer item must require at least one grammatical decision from the intended meaning or a changed context: case/role, number, person, tense, agreement controller, head–dependent relation, applicable stem pattern, or an exception. Merely naming a table cell is retrieval, not transfer.

A lexical substitution counts as useful transfer when it changes a relevant grammatical choice or tests a different applicable pattern; swapping same-gender/same-pattern/same-number nouns in an unchanged answer is weak evidence.

For each newly productive construction or major inflectional contrast, provide at least two independent applications, including one contrast/error or context change that requires choosing the rule. A larger task may cover several features; do not multiply drills mechanically.

Do not print a complete target answer or its requested analysis in exposition, worked models, or another new reading. Compare whole responses and semantic role structures, not merely repeated words or unavoidable reference forms.

Reference checks and retrieval can remain explicitly labelled, but do not count them toward the two-application threshold. Preserved Cook items may likewise be controlled practice rather than the only transfer evidence.

For every task, distinguish what the learner must derive from what the help already states. Guided comprehension of supplied material is legitimate, but cannot certify its independent recall or a new productive milestone.

Do not create difficulty by removing prerequisites, inventing unattested forms/senses, multiplying ambiguities without meaning cues, requiring untaught pronouns, or silently expanding reference-only cells into production.
Require at least one fresh connected reading and one cumulative task per unit that combine taught decisions, with explicit support for every remaining dependency. The full key stays separate.
